description: Read the conditional (Smart Links) redirect rules currently set on one code. An empty array means the code always goes to its primary destination. Call this before qrtap_set_smart_rules, which replaces the whole rule set — otherwise you will silently drop rules you did not know about.

codeId.description: The code id (UUID), as returned by qrtap_create_code, qrtap_create_codes_bulk or qrtap_list_codes. This is the internal id, not the short_url slug.

name: qrtap_get_smart_rules
